results.title: Two Officers Hospitalized After Crashing Into Each Other During State Street Response
results.description: SANTA BARBARA, Calif. (KEYT) – Two local police department vehicles collided with each other and two officers are in stable condition after a call for backup for a police response on State Street Tuesday evening. On Sep. 15, around 9:30 p.m., officers in two separate marked police vehicles responded to a request for immediate backup The post Two Officers Hospitalized After Crashing Into Each Other During State Street Response appeared first on News Channel 3-12 .

results.title: Milwaukee Co. judge who helped man evade ICE keeps her law license
results.description: MADISON, Wis. -- The Wisconsin Supreme Court will not suspend the law license of a former Milwaukee County judge who was convicted of obstructing federal agents after she helped a man evade ICE.
